svg.title: SpendSnap — Component Diagram (Layered Architecture: client + Cloud Function)

g.text: SpendSnap — Component Diagram (Layered Architecture: client + Cloud Function)
4 · Pure Utilities — utils/ (no React, no network, unit-tested)
Single seam for change: swapping the
database, or adding caching or logging,
The only server-side code in the repo. It exists
because the OpenAI key cannot ship in the bundle.
parser.js keeps the prompt and the normalisation
pure, so 5 tests cover it with a mocked API.
Every layer above may use these — including
services/, for the budget-alert copy — and
they depend on nothing app-specific in return.
No knowledge of Firebase ⇒ reusable and
testable with props alone. PieChart is generic;
it happens to render per-member group spend today.
